title: Authentication bypass via X-Impersonation-Token header
evidence: auth.go:18-31; tenant.go:39-63; cors.go:25 :: auth.go:19-31 ("If impersonation token is present, allow the request ... Temporary value"); tenant.go:39-63 header fallback when claims lack tenant+restaurant; cmd/api/main.go:595-646 every wrapper starts with middleware.AuthMiddleware. The real impersonation validator (middleware.ImpersonationMiddleware, impersonation.go:33) is defined but never wired (grep: no caller). Static reading only; not exercised at runtime.
suspected_root_cause: Shortcut left in middleware to make the impersonation frontend work ("frontend already validated it").
recommended_fix: Delete the bypass branch; wire ImpersonationMiddleware (or a JWT-based equivalent) that validates the token via ImpersonationRepository and sets tenant/user from the session.
required_tests: Request with only X-Impersonation-Token + X-Tenant-ID/X-Restaurant-ID returns 401 on every protected route; valid impersonation token yields claims of the target user with an impersonation flag; audit-log entry created.

title: RBAC "wrapWithPermission(module, level)" is decorative: permission is never checked
evidence: permission.go:16-24; main.go:621-629,631-640; product_handler.go:33-48; notification_handler.go:32-45 :: grep for RequiredModuleContextKey|RequiredPermissionContextKey: only permission.go:11-20 hits; product_handler.go:44-48 empty step 2; internal/auth/rbac_manager.go (HasPermission, line 312) is not referenced from cmd/api. The only RBAC test (cmd/api/main_phase6_rbac_routes_test.go:22) regex-matches main.go text and never issues a request.
suspected_root_cause: Middleware was scaffolded to carry intent (comments reference a PermissionMiddleware(permissionUC) that was commented out, main.go:624) but the check was never implemented.
recommended_fix: Implement enforcement middleware using RolePermissionRepository/UserRoleRepository (already in main.go), run in log-only mode, then enforce.
required_tests: For each of the 200 wrapped routes: token without permission -> 403, with READ only on a WRITE route -> 403, owner -> 200; cross-tenant role must not grant access.

title: RBAC administration endpoints have no caller-authorization: any tenant user can grant themselves permissions/roles
evidence: main.go:924-947; rbac_permission_handler.go:35-92; rbac_user_role_handler.go:34-55; rbac_role_handler.go:144,220 :: rbac_permission_handler.go:36-91 (claims nil check then rolePermissionRepo.Assign); rbac_user_role_handler.go:35-50 (tenant match then userRoleRepo.Assign). No occurrence of an admin/owner check in rbac_user_role_handler.go (grep "admin|owner" returns nothing); rbac_role_handler.go matches are only IsSystemRole fields.
suspected_root_cause: Handlers were written assuming a middleware gate (see BE-002).
recommended_fix: Add owner/admin check in handlers or a RequirePermission(rbac_module, ADMIN) wrapper once BE-002 exists.
required_tests: Non-admin token -> 403 on every /rbac write route; admin cannot remove last owner; self-assignment of higher role -> 403; audit row written.

title: Sensitive mutations protected only by login (no RBAC wrapper): users, drivers, themes, categories, notifications, tenant contact info
evidence: main.go:702-756 (contact-info), 1062-1290 (users), 1341-1352 and surrounding driver/theme/category routes (see inventory flag NO-RBAC) :: main.go:1133-1204 POST /users inline; 1264-1291 DELETE inline; 07-COMPLETE-API-INVENTORY.md rows flagged NO-RBAC(BE-004).
suspected_root_cause: Routes added incrementally with wrapProtected as the default wrapper.
recommended_fix: Add module IDs for users/drivers/themes/categories and enforce.
required_tests: Per-route negative tests (non-privileged token -> 403); delete-last-owner and delete-self guards.

title: Tenant/restaurant can be taken from request headers even on authenticated routes
evidence: tenant.go:24-63 :: tenant.go:31 (&&), 39-63; README says "Extracts tenant_id + restaurant_id from JWT claims" (README.md TenantContextMiddleware row). Whether production JWTs with restaurant_id=0 exist was not verified (needs DB/data).
recommended_fix: Remove header fallback on authenticated chains; reject mismatches.
required_tests: JWT(tenant A, restaurant 0) + X-Tenant-ID: B -> 403/ignored; JWT(A,R1) + X-Restaurant-ID: R2 -> 403.

title: Unauthenticated order endpoints trust client-supplied tenant/restaurant headers and expose full orders by sequential id (IDOR) incl. cancel
evidence: main.go:455-482; public_order_handler.go:37-111,115-157,370-420; order_usecase.go:218-230 :: main.go:469-482; public_order_handler.go:116-157 returns `"data": order`; :385-420 CancelOrder; order_usecase.go:218-229 auto-confirm for pos source.
suspected_root_cause: Public API designed on top of internal tenant middleware.
recommended_fix: Introduce tracking token + slug-based resolution; restrict fields.

title: Paymob webhook signature check is a no-op unless PAYMOB_MODE=live; production compose defaults to mock
evidence: paymob_client_mock.go:51-54; main.go:197-210,425-432; docker-compose.prod.yml:74; .env.prod.example:24; mock_paymob_handler.go:243-252 :: See cited lines. HandleWebhook (payment_usecase.go:176-188) relies solely on VerifyHMAC for authenticity; it then checks stored amount == plan price, so an attacker needs a valid paymob_order_id (integer) of a pending payment and no signature.
suspected_root_cause: Mock-by-default convenience for local dev leaked into prod templates.
recommended_fix: Fail fast in production for non-live mode.
required_tests: Production-mode boot test: PAYMOB_MODE empty -> process exits; webhook with bad hmac -> 401 in every mode other than explicit dev mock.

title: Tenant subscription/suspension status is enforced on exactly one route
evidence: main.go:610-618,681; tenant_status.go:36-60 :: grep wrapProtectedWithStatus in main.go: lines 610 (definition) and 681 (only use). tenant_status.go itself has a cache and skip-list, i.e. it was designed to be global.

recommended_fix: Fold TenantStatusMiddleware into wrapProtected/wrapWithPermission with skip list.
required_tests: Disabled tenant -> 403 on /products etc.; allowed on /subscription/*; expired trial boundary tests.

title: Order creation is non-atomic and order numbers are globally unique but derived from the clock
evidence: order_usecase.go:64,190-203; order_repo.go:24,630; domain/order.go:240-244; 060_create_orders_table.sql:11 :: order_usecase.go:64 `GenerateOrderNumber(tenantID, time.Now().Unix()%1000000)`; domain/order.go:242-243 ignores tenantID; migration 060 line 11 `order_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE`.
